name: db_qa_agent
description: Agentic Q&A workflow: answers user questions by querying a database via MCP tools. The LLM decides whether to call the MCP tool (zero, one, or multiple times) before producing a final answer.

inputParameters.instructions: You are a database assistant. Use the provided tools to query the database and answer the user's question accurately. Call the tool as many times as needed. When you have sufficient information, give a concise, accurate final answer without calling any more tools.

tools.name: query_database
tools.description: Query the database. Use this tool to look up records, run queries, or retrieve schema information.

arguments.description: Arguments passed to the database tool (e.g. SQL query, table name, filter conditions)
